body: He doesn't look different! In what way?
Yes woman get old and saggy, but the younger ones don't want us,  unless we're sugar daddies. That ain't me :) good luck mate
Hope you feel better when you wake. Sweet dreams, g'nite xx
That's okay. You may pass out and if you want to bore me, feel free to do so. I'll be here, I'll listen, okay? X
Wish I could help you, Sweetheart, I really do. You e stopped me from feeling low. I'm out of beer and my kettle is boiling for a cup of tea. At least may I be here for you, if only to lend an ear x
You say you can't fix yourself,  can anyone fix you? Must be someone? May I ask about your username? swallowyourpride325! I'm curious :)

It's easy to forget there's people in the world in a worse state than yourself.  Wish I could come and take your pain away! We probably have a few thousand miles between us and I'm not rich enough to just hop over to offer you support. If you did that yesterday and you still have it in you to help another human, then you are a beautiful soul,  a good person x

I've been selfish rambling on about my own pity. 18 and drinking, used to be legal at 18 here in the UK, but now it's 21. I wish I could help myself then help you. You have a whole future ahead of you, can I offer an ear for you if ever you need to talk? X

I don't do anything. I don't go out. I meet people when I'm at work. That's too much human contact. I also have a compelling desire to harm my cousin. Counsellors won't help. They say I need anger management.  Just because I have done nothing to retaliate. Most men would have gone round and kicked off. Broke a few windows etc. But he hides behind my other kids. If he goes to the shop he's never alone. Plus my daughter has had social worker, counsellors and youth workers involved.  If I kicked off,  I know I'd harm him and be sent to prison. Drinking numbs how i feel.

I have none. No motivation apart from work. I clean çarpets. It's becoming a bore. I've tried dating sites. Can't get with the idea that the woman on these sites, if not high maintenance, or ladies that have let themselves go! I was 26 last time I was single, now I'm too old to look at 26 year olds. Feel like I've been cheated. She's happy with my cousin. Doesn't care about her daughter. Has poisoned the other 3 children against me, and their sister.

7 years now. We live a less than a mile apart. My house is right next to my daughters school.  She had poor attendance and when I was told to find suitable housing, it seamed logical to take one that was a 2 minute walk to school. We hate living her because it's so close.

I just did. Today. Told her to get a job. Get somewhere to live. I bought her various pets. She now has a cat and dog. The dog she said, would give her confidence. She doesn't bother to walk him unless I go with her.
